description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ImmutablePlaceholderResolver class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.placeholders package. It tests immutability, equals and hashCode consistency, and placeholder resolution based on different types such as Map, ThingId, and TopicPath.

classes.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolverTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying immutability and placeholder resolution functionality of ImmutablePlaceholderResolver.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutablePlaceholderResolver instances are immutable using MutabilityAssert.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutablePlaceholderResolver implements proper equals and hashCode methods using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnMap
methods.description: Tests resolving placeholders based on a Map<String, String>.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnThingId
methods.description: Tests resolving placeholders based on a ThingId instance.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnTopic
methods.description: Tests resolving placeholders based on a TopicPath object.
